dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the mid-lateral flank. The three most prominent exhibit sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior pixels to high-intensity white internal centers, with perimeters characterized by irregular, non-uniform pixel-width boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is present between the macro-annuli. These clusters lack internal value gradients and are most concentrated along the lower ventral-lateral transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-flank annuli form a non-equilateral triangle. A secondary linear spatial relationship is formed by four high-intensity blobs positioned along the posterior-dorsal midline.
